title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Eighty-Five by Transferring the Branch of the Philippine Institute of Fisheries Technology from Butuan City to Barrio Matabao, Municipality of Buenavista, Province of Agusan
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Eighty-Five by Transferring the Branch of the Philippine Institute of Fisheries Technology from Butuan City to Barrio Matabao, Municipality of Buenavista, Province of Agusan

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5018_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (b) of sub-paragraph ten, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred eighty-five is hereby amended to read as follows:
(b) Matabao, Buenavista, Agusan ₱50,000"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
